# Little Taco Factory

> Taqueria in San Antonio, Texas. Bean and cheese tacos, hot coffee with flavored cream, friendly service. Monday through Saturday.

- Offers: Breakfast tacos; Cheese enchiladas and plates; Crunchy tacos and coffee
